description:
CRITICAL RECOVERY TASK: An aggressive inbox cleanup accidentally deleted important project emails. You must recover them from the Trash. 

1. Navigate to the Trash folder.
2. Identify emails from the 'exmh-workers' and 'ILUG' (Irish Linux Users Group) mailing lists. These contain critical technical discussions.
3. Create a new folder named 'Recovered-Critical'.
4. Move ONLY the exmh-workers and ILUG emails from Trash to 'Recovered-Critical'. Leave the other legitimate junk in Trash.
5. Draft an email to 'ops-manager@techcorp.org' with the subject 'Recovery Complete', confirming that you have recovered the critical mailing list threads. 

Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
